records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Blue Media!
records.body:
Hi Wei,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, zero engagement: no reply to welcome [email:02300d46] or check-in [email:b5ac46b8], no-show at onboarding call [calendar:8db7775d], no tickets, no project, no invites. Pro plan and 8 days left leave some chance, but silence after multiple touches suggests low unaided activation.

draft.subject: Quick help getting Blue Media's first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

No worries about missing our onboarding time last week — I know launch weeks get busy. Whenever you're ready, the first step in Wrenfield is usually a single project: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. Once that's in place, inviting the rest of the team is quick, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything else as we go.

Best,
Priya
